# NutriCam

> NutriCam: AI Nutrient Tracker is an iPhone nutrition advisor by LAYERTWO, LLC (App Store id6745231558). Photograph a meal or say what you ate, see estimated calories, macros, and vitamins and minerals, then ask what to eat next. The advisor uses today's logged meals, your targets, workouts, and Apple Health sleep when connected. iPhone only. Not on Android. Free download with an optional subscription.

NutriCam is not nutricam.org, not NutriCamp (nutricamp.ai), not NutriScan (nutriscan.app), and not any app named NutriCam on Google Play. Nutrition numbers from a photo are estimates, not lab values. NutriCam is not a medical device.
